findings.explanation: The agreement requires you to perform additional unmentioned services without any change-order mechanism or extra compensation.
findings.suggested_change: The Consultant will provide the services specifically set forth herein, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be subject to a written change order and agreed additional compensation.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a great week. Thank you for sharing the contract. I am excited to work together, but I would like to propose a minor adjustment to the agreement before I sign. - In the relevant clause, the agreement requires performing additional unmentioned services without any change-order mechanism or extra compensation, and I suggest modifying this so that the consultant provides the services specifically set forth herein, with any additional services subject to a written change order and agreed additional compensation. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
